acceptance: Exact revision-bound source, test, generator/output and reference-page manifest is frozen against the shared ownership map before edits; no overlap, unknown provenance or unresolved consumer is deleted.

Every maintained first-party source/payload in the frozen scope reaches zero discretionary comments and explanatory docstrings, including generated forms; runtime __doc__ readers/writers are removed or migrated to actually consumed data.

Remaining machine directives have actual consumer/necessity, considered non-comment alternative, minimum permitted syntax and stable owner/removal trigger; required notices have provenance and governing-form proof. No appended explanatory prose survives.

Useful contracts/rationale are verified in owning external references, actual product metadata and effective tests before source deletion; unsupported/filler claims disappear. TODO/FIXME obligations and active links have named destinations; historical evidence remains untouched.

Source-only slices pass narrow executable parity and byte-identical SQL/data/output-input comparisons. SQL/output identity changes use separately disclosed payload batches with raw-hash, non-comment token/order/parameter/hint and relevant correctness/plan/timing evidence; historical bundles and identity algorithms are not rewritten.

Any simplification, typing or behavior change has its own evaluated disposition and separate approved/reviewed slice. Preserve supported public interfaces, lazy imports, mono_time/elapsed_seconds timing, seeds, synchronization, redaction and measurement semantics.

Bounded meaningful checks cover existing contracts and rejection cases without duplicate mirror tests, empty assertions, skips/xfails, lowered thresholds, broadened ignores or arbitrary coverage rebaselines. Final scoped checker/exception audit passes.

Closeout records exact base/head, authorized paths, destinations, remaining exceptions, source/payload/behavior PR separation, required reviews, pr-preflight and live merge/CI proof. Module completion is not live UAT, release or publication approval.

description:
Exclusive candidate scope: Exact maintained executable blocks/assets in docs and other first-party documentation, excluding module-owned reference pages, shared integrator pages and generator-owned outputs; matching tests/generators/outputs/reference pages only as frozen by scope-policy. Exclude other task manifests, shared integrator files, upstream/external mirrors and historical evidence. Unknown ownership/consumer blocks deletion; never expand a worker scope unilaterally.

Target: zero discretionary explanatory comments and authored explanatory docstrings in maintained first-party code. Only proven minimum machine directives and unavoidable provenance-bound required notices remain. Useful product strings must have an actual consumer; no inert constants, unused strings, fake metadata or dynamic __doc__ replacements. Never broaden lint/type/coverage ignores, weaken assertions, or turn unknown ownership/parser coverage into an exclusion.

Required work and decisions: Assign page-level ownership, not competing block edits in the same file. Remove discretionary comments/docstrings inside runnable samples and keep needed explanation in adjacent prose. Historical quoted source/evidence is classified separately. Preserve supported example syntax/contracts and actual help; no rewriting frozen evidence to match current code.

Trace substantive explanation to requirement, callers, actual behavior and existing tests. Delete filler/false claims; move necessary contracts/rationale to owning external references or actually consumed metadata before deleting source text. Evaluate the smallest adequate mechanism; executable simplification/type/behavior changes require separate approval and reviewed slices, with no new abstraction solely to house prose. Preserve runtime/output consumers before removal.

Deliver source-only deletion and, where relevant, later dedicated SQL/output payload batches with explicit identity/correctness evidence. One ownership task may need multiple pilot-budget-approved PRs. Shared documentation must be published by its owner before affected deletion. Execution guard: creation of this TODO is planning, not approval to execute the reviewed cleanup. Obtain later implementation authorization. Use a separate linked worktree and agent-write-preflight; preserve unrelated work. Freeze nonoverlapping code/test/doc paths with the integrator before dispatch. Ordinary independent PRs target develop; serialize shared test-lock checks and integration, not module edits. Required native/external soundness review remains mandatory, with no auto-merge bypass. No live cloud/stress, deployment, publication, historical-result rewriting, or unapproved external-repository writes.

Scope assigned by the scope policy (quality/comment-cleanup-scope.json, PR #2515): (1) Markdown pages under results-data/, _blog/, _project/, _sources/ and tests/ that fail the markdown-prose verifier (a code fence, indented code, an HTML or template comment marker, or a link reference definition) are blocked under this owner by the format class markdown-pages-to-classify; (2) .py and .sh research scripts under _blog/ by blog-research-code. Classify each page or script as maintained documentation with runnable samples, or as frozen historical evidence, which needs an explicit owner decision to exclude, before any edit. Historical _project and _blog pages were not named in this description before; they are now in scope for classification. (3) The documentation pages under docs/ that render docstrings through Sphinx autodoc (27 pages, 44 consumer edges in the policy) are consumers: publish the useful reference or remove the autodoc directive before the producing module's docstring is deleted.
